Atomic reservations enforce canonical kind-3 scope, current batch policy, serialized TTLs, complete accounting and fee caps. Process sessions retain startup, policy and admission watermarks. Remembered policy floors compose across observers while fresh reloads still reject rollback and conflicts; observed clock, policy or history rollback latches restart. Wallet delivery journals exact unsent bytes before fresh two-copy publication and census confirmation, then grants single-use exact-byte permission with synchronous final admission and expiry checks. Publication failures retry the retained bytes. The serial standing controller confirms both copies before preparing, resumes exact journal bytes, waits for authenticated settlement and publishes proof-backed landing. Planning requires intact retained plans for every follower commitment. Retained history validation checks one new plan per turn, remembers unchanged identities and invalidates on external SQLite commits or local abandonment. Local persistence is trusted; service lifetime ownership remains separate. Verified append-only checkpoint history renews bounded advancement allowance at authenticated successors while retaining the original signed scope for historical replay. Retained-state startup uses distance-sized budgets capped at 45 minutes, 760 HTTP requests and 64 MiB; ordinary turns remain 90 seconds, 256 requests and 64 MiB. Recoverable startup failures enter a five-second retry hold with bounded progress rather than systemd restart churn; policy continuity faults still require recovery/restart. No live maintenance activation or host upgrade is implied.

primitives.name: Midnight receipt proof discovery
primitives.desc: Locates SHA-addressed member and set hints, binds the exact requested receipt ID/content/certificate, reconstructs portable proofs and independently verifies current author policy, execution and GRANDPA finality through isolated RPC sources. One shared request/decoded-byte/deadline budget bounds all HTTP; resumable forward progress is independent of damaged-evidence repair. Unresolved or exhausted hints never prove chain absence or coverage.

primitives.name: Finalized certified receipt census
primitives.desc: Reads every Materios receipt at one fixed finalized block through bounded storage RPC, validates Blake2_128Concat keys and exact SCALE values, classifies certificate provenance with shared core primitives, and preserves pending or contradicted entries. Re-enumeration observes late certification; independent coverage recount is required because RPC completeness is an operator trust boundary.

primitives.name: Durable Midnight census plans
primitives.desc: Private versioned SQLite state atomically persists canonical census snapshots, kind-3 plans, permanent receipt claims and publication outbox. Confirmation rechecks fresh certificates. Combined landing requires current public consensus verification before immutable set staging and after fresh two-copy member/plan/set readbacks, then atomically retains the exact landed set. Interrupted publication resumes without another transaction; landing does not settle uncertain attempts or release their fees.

primitives.name: Midnight retained proof publisher
primitives.desc: Reads back every canonical member, recovery-plan and optional landed-set object from two retained proof stores before durable acknowledgement, including previously acknowledged objects. Exact byte digests, member-before-plan-before-set ordering, bounded reads and deadlines, credential-free public reads and redirect refusal preserve recovery preconditions across restart. Independent storage ownership is an operator prerequisite.

primitives.name: Hosted Midnight standing service
primitives.desc: Owns the canonical shared execution lock through wallet sync, authenticated catch-up, serial batch preparation, guarded delivery and final persistence. Delivery checks the node's current runtime (assertKnownRuntime with the registry) against the exact bytes just before the send permit, since the follower's newest verified block can trail the node across a fork: bytes of another ledger stay journalled and unsent with their DUST held. Observe mode loads no spending or writer secrets; agent-driven mainnet anchor mode refuses before shared mutations. The bounded follower runs during slow proofs; typed verified forward-head races retry identical bytes at most three times while restore and policy faults remain refusals. Cancellation unsubscribes wallet sync, drains both loops and closes storage before releasing the lock. Supplies a user unit and explicit private configuration; activation and coverage verification remain operator tasks. Existing wallet endpoint selection is unchanged. Startup replays installed checkpoint history before controller initialization and preserves retained accounting through the additive v3 migration; follower schema 4 records each block's runtime instead of scoping the follower to runtime 1000300, binding it to the registry generation's spans (an unpinned registry: a runtime the decoder knows, never an earlier one), migrates a schema 1 to 3 file scoped to 1000300 in place, and admits a standing batch only under the head block's runtime and that runtime's ledger; a retained status scoped to 1000300 keeps its cap history, and the watch and accounting configurations drop the runtime from their scopes at the same redeploy; rollout, schedule, publication credential and accepted-history installation remain operator work.
